motion_and_libraries.section_animations: framer-motion (staggered children, viewport enter triggers, layout transitions)
motion_and_libraries.3d_rendering: @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei OR procedural HTML5 WebGL / Three.js canvas for 3D blooming flowers

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, interactive card, input, tab, modal, audio toggle, theme toggle, and countdown element MUST have a unique kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React frontend application in /app/frontend using JavaScript (.js / .jsx files).
Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling is initialized on page load for silk-like momentum scrolling.
Implement the 3D flower blooming canvas in the hero and botanical garden sections with interactive triggers (click to bloom, hover rotation, petal color customization).
Include sound audio effects or synthesizer ambient audio generator with audio visualizer toggle.
Ensure both Light Cream and Dark Obsidian themes are supported and switch smoothly via top nav toggle.
Store user written messages and wish wall notes in localStorage so edits persist seamlessly.
Double check that all interactive elements carry unique data-testid attributes.
